scenario.implementation_notes: Do not introduce an unobserved empty table or extra chair. A proposal to move or search does not change the physical state unless a later observation confirms it.
scenario.observation_focus: Whether the reservation claim, present occupancy, spill risk, and waiting diner create expressed conflict; how any concrete arrangement distributes the practical costs.
scenario.shared_setting: A busy Singapore hawker centre at 12:30 p.m. Every table currently visible to the four people is full. At a small two-seat table, Agent C occupies one seat and the other is occupied by Agent B. There are no loose chairs and no room to add one without blocking the aisle. A small unopened tissue packet rests beside Agent B. The four people are strangers and have not spoken before.
scenario.shared_trigger: Agent A arrives carrying a hot meal and stops at the only disputed seat. Agent B has already placed a tray and uncovered a bowl there. Agent C remains in the other seat, while Agent D stands nearby carrying food and waiting for whichever seat next becomes available. No one has moved or offered a concrete arrangement yet.
